title: SAP Analytics Cloud Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: SAP Analytics Cloud audit and activity exports via the SAC API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sac:audit
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for SAP Analytics Cloud and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that SAP Analytics Cloud is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest SAP Analytics Cloud logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of SAP Analytics Cloud error rate with anomaly band.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of SAP Analytics Cloud errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
